entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram label_replace input publishes %s sample kind (%T), want histogram
entries.rationale: labelCallOverExpHistogram admits the call only when its argument isExpHistogramValuedShape, and this function lowers that same argument through lowerExpHistogramValuedShape. Every successful matched branch publishes SampleKindHistogram, so any other kind is an internal recognizer/lowerer disagreement.
